garage.title: Garage
garage.sortHint: Touch and hold a vehicle or drag its handle to change the order. Your main vehicle stays on top.
garage.sortHintWeb: Drag a vehicle by its handle, or select the handle and use the arrow keys. Your main vehicle stays on top.
garage.deleteDraftBody: The draft and its photos will be deleted.
garage.emptyBody: Add your car, log its specs and mods and get your QR sticker for the window.
garage.sortOffline: You can't change the order while offline.
garage.loadErrorTitle: Your garage could not be loaded.
garage.loadErrorBody: The server did not answer. Your vehicles are safe – try again in a moment.

guest.title: Your garage is waiting
guest.body: Sign in to add vehicles, document mods and get your QR code.

restricted.body: Your account is restricted. You can't add or edit vehicles right now.
restricted.until: Your account is restricted until {{date}}. Until then you can't add or edit vehicles.
restricted.suspended: Your account is suspended. You can view your vehicles but not edit them.

gone.vehicleBody: It was deleted or isn't part of your garage.

error.title: That didn't work
error.offlineBody: This data isn't saved on your device yet. Connect and try again.

errors.save: Saving didn't work. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Your changes aren't saved yet.
errors.networkCreating: No answer from the server. It may have arrived anyway. Go ahead and try again – nothing will be saved twice.
errors.keyReused: This was already sent once with different details. Check what was saved.
errors.rateLimited: Too many changes in a short time. Try again in {{wait}}.
errors.gone: This no longer exists. Go back to your garage.

offline.wizard: Offline – saving works again once you're back online.
offline.editor: Offline – saving works again once you're back online.
offline.photos: Offline – photos will upload once you're back online.

editor.savedWithHistory: Saved. An entry will appear in the history.

catalog.notFoundHelper: We'll save what you type and review it for the catalogue.
catalog.noMatchFreeText: Check the spelling or type the name yourself.

basics.title: Basics
basics.nicknameHelper: Optional. Helps others find your car in search.
basics.descriptionPlaceholder: What makes your car special? Its story, the goal of the build, what comes next.
basics.freeTextHelper: Not in the catalogue – we'll review the name.
basics.deleteBodyPublished: The page and all mods disappear, and your QR code stops working. This can't be undone.
basics.deleteBodyDraft: The draft and its photos will be deleted. This can't be undone.

specs.title: Specs
specs.huAuHelperEmpty: Enter the month on the inspection sticker. We remind you 30 days before. Only you can see it.
specs.huAuHelper: We remind you on {{date}}, 30 days before. Only you can see the date.
specs.huAuHelperPassed: The date is less than 30 days away. No reminder will follow.
specs.huAuHelperDue: The HU/AU inspection is due this month.
specs.huAuHelperOverdue: The HU/AU inspection was due in {{month}}. Enter the new month after the inspection.

wizard.title: Add vehicle
wizard.caption: Step {{step}} of {{total}} · {{name}}
wizard.limitReached: Delete a vehicle or a draft to add a new one.
wizard.photoRequired: Add at least one photo. A vehicle can't be published without one.
wizard.goneBody: It was deleted or already published. Your garage has all your vehicles.

review.incomplete: Some details are still missing. Add them, then you can publish.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.label: Visibility

public.title: Public
public.body: In search, in the feed, on your profile and through your QR code.

unlisted.title: Unlisted
unlisted.body: Only through the link and your QR code. Not in search or the feed.

private.title: Private
private.body: Only you see the vehicle. A scan shows: “This vehicle is private.”

saved.unlisted: Your vehicle is now visible through the link and QR code only

visibility.restricted: Your account is restricted. You can make your vehicle private, but not public.
visibility.plateBody: You decide what your photos show. Delete or replace a photo if a number plate or a bystander can be recognised.

ownerOnQr.label: Owner on the QR page
ownerOnQr.helper: When it is off, only you see your name on your vehicle pages, and new sticker PDFs leave it out.
ownerOnQr.loadFailed: This setting could not be loaded.
ownerOnQr.offline: Offline – this setting loads as soon as you are online.

owner.editTitle: What do you want to edit?

draft.title: Draft – not published yet
draft.body: Only you see it. Review the details and publish it.

private.title: Private
private.body: Only you see this vehicle. A scan of your QR code shows that it's private.

unlisted.title: Unlisted
unlisted.body: Visible through the link and your QR code only, not in search or the feed.

photos.title: Photos
photos.failedBody: This photo couldn't be processed. Delete it and upload it again.
photos.deleteBody: The photo will be removed from your build.
photos.deleteLastBody: It's the last photo. Your public page will then show no picture.
photos.sortHint: Touch and hold a photo or drag its handle. The first one is the cover unless you set one.
photos.sortHintWeb: Drag a photo by its handle, or select the handle and use the arrow keys.

upload.network: No connection. The upload starts again once you're online.
upload.rateLimited: Too many uploads in a short time. Uploading resumes automatically in a moment.
upload.rateLimitedLong: You've uploaded a lot of photos in a short time. Try again in {{wait}}.
upload.inFlight: The server is still processing this photo. Uploading resumes automatically in a moment.
upload.keyReused: Something got mixed up during the upload. Remove the photo and choose it again.
upload.tooLarge: The photo is larger than 15 MB. Choose a smaller one.
upload.unsupported: This file type isn't supported. Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
upload.server: The upload didn't work. Please try again.
upload.prepare: The photo couldn't be opened. Choose another one.
upload.pickFailed: The photos couldn't be opened. Try again or choose different ones.

photoEdit.title: Edit photo
photoEdit.focusHint: Tap the most important part of the picture. Every crop stays centred on it.

photoEdit.position: {{x}}% from the left, {{y}}% from the top
photoEdit.altHelper: For everyone who can't see the photo.
photoEdit.goneBody: It was deleted. The photo overview shows all photos.

mods.title: Mods
mods.emptyBody: Add parts with their details: wheels, suspension, exhaust and more.
mods.sortHint: Touch and hold a modification or drag its handle to move it within its category.
mods.sortHintWeb: Drag a modification by its handle, or select the handle and use the arrow keys.

mods.unknownCategoryBody: Choose a category from the list in the mods overview.
mods.legalStatusHelper: Owner’s statement, not a legal review

legalStatusDetails.abe: General type approval for the part (ABE)
legalStatusDetails.unknown: I don’t know, or no answer

history.title: History
history.intro: Every change to mods, specs and photos appears here. Only you see hidden entries.
history.notePlaceholder: What happened? For example: first track day with the new suspension.
history.noteReused: Your first version already arrived and is in the history. Sending again adds a second note.
history.emptyBody: Once you change mods, specs or photos, your history starts here.
history.draftTitle: The history starts when you publish
history.draftBody: Changes to a draft don't appear in the history.

published.title: Your build is live.
published.body: {{vehicle}} now has its own QR code. Anyone who scans it lands right on your build page.
published.bodyFallback: Your vehicle now has its own QR code. Anyone who scans it lands right on your build page.

published.shareFailed: Sharing didn't work. Please try again.

sort.hint: Double-tap and hold, then drag. Or swipe up and down.

validation.yearRange: Enter a model year between {{min}} and {{max}}.
validation.number: Enter a number. Use a point for decimals.
validation.option: Choose an entry from the list.
validation.month: Enter month and year, for example 03/2023.
validation.monthFuture: The installation date can't be in the future. If it's still to come, choose “Planned”.
validation.cost: Enter an amount in euros, for example 2,400 or 89.90. Use a point for cents.
validation.huAuFormat: Enter month and year, for example 03/2027.
validation.huAuTooEarly: That is more than two years ago.
validation.huAuTooLate: The next HU/AU inspection is at most three years ahead.

blur.intro: Make number plates or faces unrecognisable: drag a rectangle over each spot.
blur.full: A photo can have at most {{max}} areas.
blur.stageHint: Drag a rectangle over a number plate or face.
blur.regionLabel: Area {{number}}: {{x}} % from the left, {{y}} % from the top, {{w}} × {{h}} %
blur.regionKeys: Arrow keys move it, with Alt larger or smaller, with Shift in big steps. Delete removes the area.
blur.regionActions: Move the area with the actions, or make it larger or smaller.
blur.previewHint: The preview draws the areas blurred. The server pixelates them in every size of the photo.

blur.processing: Making it unrecognisable. The new images appear shortly.
blur.done: The photo is now unrecognisable in the marked areas.
blur.notReady: The photo is still being processed. Then you can mark areas.

ai.pasteHelper: An invoice line or a shop description, for example. 500 characters at most.
ai.nothingFound: We didn’t find any details for this category in that text.
ai.describeHint: From your vehicle’s make, model, specs and mods. Check the text before you keep it.
ai.describeReplaced: Suggestion inserted. It replaced your previous text.
